w: At 12 noon, Swamishri was welcomed at Moi International Airport, Mombasa, by the Mayor Mr. Mwalimu Mahima and Deputy Mayor Abdul Latif Ubwa and other officials. An evening assembly was held at the Hindu Union Shivalaya Mandir. After performing arti of Lord Mahadev and applying sandalwood paste and flowers, Swamishri was honored in the assembly by the devotees and local leaders. 2,000 devotees and well-wishers had attended the grand assembly.
On the occasion of the mandir's 17th murti-pratishtha anniversary (Patotsav) Swamishri performed arti of Thakorji and blessed the assembly.
At 10.45 am Swamishri sanctified a proposed site for the mandir with flowers and prayers.

The evening Children's Day program included a drama by children and volunteers, "Haiyana Het na Bhulaye" that depicted the love Swamishri has shared with children. Two traditional dances were performed by children.

Vishwashanti Mahayagna and Nagar Yatra Swamishri performed the yagna rituals and consecrated the murtis for the new traditional style mandir. About 350 people participated in the yagna as part of the murti-pratishtha ceremony.

In the afternoon a grand procession paraded through the streets of Lenasia, from 3:00 pm to 6:30 pm, displaying ornately decorated floats carrying the murtis to be consecrated in the mandir. The murtis of Shri Akshar Purushottam Maharaj, Shri Radha-Krishna Dev, Shri Sita-Ram with Hanumanji, Shri Shiv-Parvati with Ganapatiji, and the Guru Parampara were displayed on the floats. BAPS sadhus sang kirtans as devotees in traditional dress danced with joy and devotion. The parade route passed by all the main mandirs in Lenasia. Thousands of people, representing Hindu organisations from around the country participated in this parade with traditional dances and singing.

Swamishri celebrated the shraddh of Shastriji Maharaj in the presence of over 200 sadhus. In the shraddh assembly sadhus sang the glory of Shastriji Maharaj. The Yuvak Mandal of Delhi performed a cultural dance. Finally, Swamishri blessed the congregation. “Through the wish of Shastriji Maharaj and Yogiji Maharaj this divine Akshardham has come up on the banks of the river Yamuna. We are all sitting here in this divine place. The knowledge of Akshar and Purushottam is true, endorsed by the shastras, experiential, and propagated by Bhagwan Swaminarayan. Shastriji Maharaj had firmly understood this knowledge. He was very intelligent. He became a sadhu at a young age and had come to do God’s work. He was divine and full of bhakti in his life. Even while playing he built sand-mandirs and performed arti. He is eternal, and wedded to dharma, gnan, vairagya and bhakti.”
Today after the meetings, Mahant Swami Maharaj came to the dining room earlier than usual. No sadhu had guessed that Swamishri would come so early. So no one was there.
Seeing this, the attendant said, "Swami! There's no one here..."
"Everyone is here; there are countless muktas," Swamishri replied.

Shriji Maharaj has said in the Vachanamrut, "Such a (gnani) person, even if he is in a kingdom, is in the forest, and even if he is in the forest, he has more joy than in a kingdom. Because he remains greatly carefree in his own spiritual joy." Such carefree joy was in the words Swamishri spoke today.

ds.t: Keep the kirtan as it is
w: Today during the meal, a sadhu, overwhelmed by Mahant Swami Maharaj's carefree joy, poured out his feelings and sang, "Live long, O support of our lives, you who are the form of Narayan... Live long, O support of our lives, you, Mahant Swami..."

As soon as he heard this, displeasure rose on Swamishri's face. He at once lovingly corrected him, saying, "Everything is included in Swamibapa." Then, clearly expressing his wish, he added, "In the future too, we should keep the kirtan just as it is."
In these words of Swamishri, devotion to his guru flowed just as it is.
Today, at the end of the meal, the sadhus prayed to Mahant Swami Maharaj, "Please give us some blessings."
Then Swamishri said, "Maharaj, Gunatitanand Swami, Bhagatji Maharaj, Shastriji Maharaj, Yogiji Maharaj and Pramukh Swami Maharaj are manifest, and they are the ones who will do the work."
In Swamishri's blessings, the lamp of the unbroken presence of the Satpurush shone brightly.

Today Mahant Swami Maharaj was seated in a plane to go from Delhi to Mumbai. At first the plane was not very cool. So the sadhus turned the AC outlets towards Swamishri. But Swamishri at once had them turned towards Harikrishna Maharaj! As the plane took to the sky, sunlight came in on the side where Swamishri and Thakorji were seated. So the attendants went to arrange that the sun would not fall on Swamishri's face, and Swamishri said, "First arrange that the sun does not fall on Thakorji."
"Thakorji first": this is Swamishri's way of life!
Today, when Mahant Swami Maharaj began his walk, a reading from Yogi Vani began.
In it came the talk: "One who has attained true knowledge of the form of the atma endures suffering joyfully but does not show it."
Swamishri said, "Suffering comes to everyone, but this one endures it smiling, while others are ruined."
It was read further: "Burn a hundred corpses and detachment arises. Go to just one wedding and all the detachment disappears."
Swamishri said, "It has happened. Ten people from London had come to become sadhus. They went to one wedding and it was all over. They went into family life."
Then it was read: "What is attainment? To remember him constantly is attainment. To have met him in manifest form is attainment."
Swamishri gave a beautiful example: "If you have money in the bank, you keep remembering it. A line keeps running in the mind: there is money, there is money."

One more sentence of Yogiji Maharaj was read: "Pray to Maharaj daily: do not make me great by seating me on a cushioned seat; make me your servant. Make me one who wipes the shoes of your devotees and sits on the steps."
Swamishri said, "This is the true state."
Swamishri gave a new definition of spiritual state.
